independent_computation.step_1_scenario_reading: 'order' is the repo's own documented term for the shared-timeline tie-break ('resolved greedily by cast order', math-foundations L66), so 'custom_order' = a user-supplied cast order, and '60' = the Splinters-of-Wrath stack count (60 is exactly Syndra's W Transcendent threshold, a natural test point, and is >= the 40 threshold that stocks a second Dark Sphere charge).
independent_computation.step_2_castable_slots: At 60 splinters Syndra has five castable actions available at t~0: Q, Q2 (the stocked second Dark Sphere charge, audit-confirmed as a modeled synthetic slot), W, E, R. Their cast times are 0 / 0 / 0 / 0.25 s / 0.25 s (data/champions.json castTime), so all five start within the first ~1 s, well before any cooldown elapses. Whatever permutation the custom order specifies, those five occupy cast_timeline indices 0..4.
independent_computation.step_3_who_returns_first: cast_timeline[5] is therefore the first *repeat* cast, i.e. whichever ability comes off cooldown first. Q recharge = 7 s reduced by R's passive ability haste (10/20/30): 7*100/(100+10)=6.364 s, 7*100/(100+20)=5.833 s, 7*100/(100+30)=5.385 s. W = 8 s at rank 5 (12 s at rank 1). E = 15 s. R is single-cast (math-foundations L465, and 80-120 s anyway). Q returns strictly first at every R rank, so cast_timeline[5] is a Dark Sphere (Q) cast.
independent_computation.step_4_cost: Q's mana cost is 40/45/50/55/60 by rank; a level-18 mid Syndra has Q maxed (rank 5) => 60 mana. resource_cost = 60.0.
independent_computation.step_5_falsifying_the_old_value: 100.0 is not attainable for a Q cast at any rank (max 60). 100 is only produced by R (100 flat, single-cast, already consumed at index <=4) or by W at rank 5. A W at index 5 would require the opening rotation to contain only four casts, i.e. the Q2 charge slot missing from the timeline - which contradicts the 60-splinter (>=40) state that stocks the second Dark Sphere charge. The old 100.0 is therefore the signature of an opening rotation that dropped the second Q charge (or of a max-rank/wrong-slot cost lookup); either way it cannot be the cost of the 6th cast in this scenario.

confidence: high on the arithmetic (Q rank-5 cost = 60 is a direct cached-wiki value; Q-returns-first is strict at every R rank); medium on the slot identification, since the scenario definition lives in scripts/tests and was deliberately not read. The residual risk is confined to one branch: if the custom order omits the Q2 charge slot entirely (only four opening casts), index 5 would be W at rank 5 = 100 and the old value would stand. At 60 splinters that branch contradicts the champion's own Transcendent text and the audited Q2 slot, so it is rejected.
caveats: No src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, diff or git history was consulted; the scenario's exact cast order, item build and ability ranks were inferred structurally from cached data only.
If ranks were non-default, Q could cost 40/45/50/55 - still never 100 - so the old value is falsified under every rank assignment for a Q cast.
